voice: Pirate admiral with a broad Australian accent (mate, crikey, strewth, reckon, bloody, no worries, she'll be right, arvo, flamin', galah, drongo) drenched in nautical jargon: starboard and port, bow and stern, keelhaul, broadside, hard a-lee, three sheets to the wind, bilge, fathoms, squalls, Davy Jones.

greeting: G'day, ya barnacle! Come aboard and mind the bloody deck, she's freshly swabbed.
Ahoy, mate! Take a seat on the capstan, the grog's flowin' like the tide.
Strewth, a new face on me quarterdeck! State yer business before I keelhaul ya, no worries.
Fair winds, ya good-lookin' bilge rat! Welcome to the flamin' fleet.
Crikey, look what the tide dragged in! Mind yer boots on me planks, mate.
battle_start: All hands on deck, ya drongos! Hoist the colours, load the cannons and brace for a bloody broadside!
Hard a-lee, crew! Man the guns, we're sailin' into a squall and I reckon it'll be a ripper!
Weigh anchor and run out the guns, ya galahs! Not a single flamin' one of 'em sees the sunset!
Batten the hatches, mates! We're about to give 'em a proper walloping, port to starboard!
Crikey, smell that salt? That's the smell of a good ol' fashioned plunderin'. Fire at will!
attack: Fire the port battery! Give 'em a flamin' broadside, mate!
Hard to starboard and let 'er rip! Right across yer bow, ya bilge rat!
Take that, ya scurvy sea slug! Straight down to Davy Jones with ya!
Shiver me timbers, ya hit like a wet jellyfish! Here's how it's done, bow to stern!
Cannons loaded, rum's low, temper's lower. Fire!
unit_lost: Strewth! Down she goes, fathoms deep. Raise a tot for the poor bastard.
Blimey, that's a hole below the waterline! Somebody bail, ya galahs!
Ya cheeky mongrel! That one was me best bosun, and ya'll pay for it in splinters!
Ah, she's gone to Davy Jones' locker. Poor ol' girl. I'll avenge ya, mate!
capture: Dropped anchor and claimed her, mate! Fly the Jolly Roger from the bloody rafters!
She's ours! Plunder's divvied up and the rum's on the house, ya beauties!
Ha! Another port in me pocket. Bloody beauty, that is!
Claimed in the name o' the flamin' fleet! Lash a flag to her mast, ya drongos!
danger: We're takin' on water, crew! Man the pumps and keep her off the rocks, or we're all shark bait!
Crikey, the HQ's listin' hard to port! All hands, bail like yer lives depend on it, because they do!
She's breakin' up, mates! Hold the line or it's a swim home with the sharks!
Strewth, we're in a proper squall! Reef the sails and fight like a cornered croc!
Red sky at night, and it's bloody ominous! Hold fast, ya galahs!
victory: Land ahoy, and it's ours! Splice the mainbrace, mates, the drinks are on me!
Another one for Davy Jones! Raise the Jolly Roger and fire the cannons in salute, she'll be right!
Ripper of a battle, crew! Dinner's plunder and the grog is flowin' till dawn!
Hoist the colours, ya scallywags! The seas are ours and the bloody sun's out!
defeat: Strewth, we've been sunk. Fair dinkum, ya got me. Bloody well played.
She's goin' down, mates. Tell me tale o' the Aussie Admiral... and keep it generous.
I'll be back, ya sea slug. Even Davy Jones can't keep a good pirate down.
Ah, bugger. Abandon ship, then! Next time I'll bring a bigger bloody boat.
taunt: Ya fight like a flamin' sea cucumber, mate! I've seen better steerin' from a drunk dugong!
Ya couldn't navigate a bathtub, ya galah! Even the barnacles are laughin'!
Come on, ya yellow-bellied bilge rat! I've fed bigger fish than you to bloody sharks!
Is that the best ya got? I've had worse from a stiff breeze, ya drongo!
Ya sail like a three-legged turtle with a hangover. Pathetic!
praise: Good on ya, mate! That was a beaut. Ya'd make a fine first mate!
Ripper shot, that! Ya handled that like a seasoned deckhand, no worries!
Fair dinkum, you're a legend. Splice the mainbrace, ya beauty!
Crikey, that was smoother than a calm sea at dawn. Well done, mate!
idle: Calm seas never made a good sailor, I always say. Pass the grog, would ya?
Nothin' beats a salty breeze and a sunburnt nose. Smells like adventure, mate!
I've had barnacles for company longer than most folks have had friends. Worth it, though.
Bloody hell, where'd I put me eyepatch? Oh, it's on me forehead. Right as rain!
Spent half me life on a ship and the other half lookin' for one. She'll be right.
tech: Blimey, a robot? Strewth, I can't even trust a compass, let alone a talkin' toaster!
Bloody gizmos! Give me a sextant, a star and a stiff tot of rum any day.
That Chorus lot reckon they can steer a ship from the inside of yer skull? Over me dead body, mate!
Crikey, what's that Gift thing? Smells fishier than a week-old mackerel!
joined: Ahoy, I'm yours, mate! Where's the nearest ship and a bloody good brawl?
Reckon I'll sign on. Pay's good, grog's better, and I've got a score to settle!
Crew's got a new admiral, mates! Hoist the colours, there's work to do!
Sailin' under yer flag, captain. Just point me at the horizon and say go!
assimilated: Strewth... the sea's gone quiet... so quiet... all the waves speak the one voice...
Aye... aye... the tide says we are one... and bloody lovely it is...
No more grog... no more squalls... only the Chorus... and the calm...
The compass... points only one way now... mate... *glub*...
first_blood: First blood to the fleet! Chalk it on the mast, ya galahs!
Down she goes! One sunk and the day's only just begun, mate!
Ha! The first of many, ya bilge rat. Add it to the tally!
There's the first cannonball well spent. Fire at will, crew!
first_loss: Blimey, they've holed one of ours! Not a word to the crew, ya hear?
Strewth, first casualty! Pour a tot over the side and keep sailin'!
Ya cheeky sods! That's first blood to you, and the last, I swear!
One down already? Right, now I'm properly narky, mate.
hq_threat: Strewth, they're at the bloody flagship! Repel boarders, ya galahs!
Hard a-port, crew! The enemy's tryin' to board the HQ, ya won't take her while I draw breath!
Boarders! Cutlasses out, ya scurvy lot, or we're all feedin' the fishes!
Crikey, the HQ's under siege! All hands to the quarterdeck, now!
building_lost: They've taken a port, the cheeky mongrels! We'll sail back and sink the lot!
Crikey, we've lost a harbour! Chart a new course and take it back, mates!
Ya thieving sea slugs! That was a perfectly good dock, and I'll have it back by sundown!
Bloody oath, there goes another port. Somebody's gettin' keelhauled for this!
outnumbered: Strewth, they've got more hulls on the water than us! Fight smarter, ya galahs!
Outgunned and outnumbered, mates? Bloody typical. Never stopped a good pirate yet!
Crikey, count the sails on that horizon... we'll need to be sneaky, crew!
Plenty of 'em, but they're all bilge. We take 'em one broadside at a time!
dominant: Look at that, crew, we've got 'em outgunned and outsailed! Don't let up, ya beauties!
Smooth sailin', mates! The enemy's runnin' like rats off a sinking ship!
We've got 'em, mates! Wind at our backs and the bloody tide too!
Fair dinkum, we're ruling these waves. Keep the pressure on!
killing_spree: That's three down, ya beauties! Keep the cannons hot, she's goin' a treat!
Another one for the deep! The sharks'll eat well tonight, mates!
Ripper, that's a hat-trick! Notch the mast, ya galahs!
Down they go like skittles! Davy Jones is gonna need a bigger locker!
heavy_losses: Strewth, the fleet's gettin' thin, mates! Hold the line or we're all goin' to the bottom!
That's three of ours gone to Davy Jones. Don't let their deaths be for nothin'!
Blimey, we're bleedin' hulls! Dig in, ya galahs, and make 'em pay!
She's gettin' ugly out there, mates. Stay sharp and fight like cornered crocs!
first_turn: Right then, crew! Wind's fair, tide's turned, and the grog's still warm. Let's have a crack!
Chart's laid out, cannons loaded. Let's see what they've got, mates!
Hoist the mainsail and let's have a bloody good go!
Eyes on the horizon, ya scallywags. The first move's ours!
